description: Simplified, atomic SMARTS feature library for deterministic chemistry tooling. Drops smartsrx-derived reactant-type expansions (including PFAS and heteroaryl leaving-group super-patterns); keeps taxonomy-mapped reactant members plus lightweight derived logic.

schema_notes.scope: global unless stated; site-level optional for future
rdkit_smart_tips: Prefer permissive SMARTS first; tighten after audits.
Use separate tokens + logic for negatives (e.g., internal_alkyne = alkyne_present AND NOT terminal_alkyne_present).
Features are designed for both deterministic detection and LLM-based reasoning about synthetic feasibility.
expansion_notes: Atomic SMARTS only in the base layer; build chemistry meaning in derived logic.
Removed smartsrx-derived reactant-type expansions (PFAS + heteroaryl leaving-group super-patterns).
Reactant-type features are limited to unified taxonomy members (reactant_metadata present).

notes: Normalized category labels (stereochemistry, redox, protecting_groups, heterocycles, organometallics, reactive_intermediates, miscellaneous).
Patched SMARTS for allylic/primary/secondary/tertiary alcohols, heteroaryl, pyrimidine, sp2_pseudohalide, sp2_boron.
Converted risk tokens (pyridine_poison_risk, thiol_poison_risk) to derive from presence flags.
Deduplicated exact duplicate tokens by name and by identical SMARTS signatures.
Set union derive rule for alcohol_present when aliphatic_alcohol_present and phenol_present exist.
Imported 396 additional reactant-type SMARTS classifiers from smartsrx.json.
One feature per smartsrx 'specific_type'; naming: <specific_type> → snake_case + '_present'.

Name-colliding tokens (e.g. anhydride_present, fmoc_present, boc_present, acetal_present, sulfone_present, carbamate_present, amide_present, oxime_present, azide_present, phenol_present) retain their original definitions; smartsrx variants are not added.
Added higher-level derived_shortcuts for activated acid derivatives, acyl halides, PFAS handles, mesylate handles, and high-energy oxidant handles.
Derived tokens use OR-combinations of newly added smartsrx-based reactant_types.
Added derived_shortcuts for activated ester handles, benzylic amines, and acidic nitrogen functionality.
These are intended to support rule logic in amide/peptide coupling, benzylic C–N functionalisation, and acidity-related heuristics.
